summary: Tested the newly wired CMS end-to-end (backend content endpoints + Admin Content Manager UI + public-page consumption of overrides) plus the two regressions (admin enquiry list after phone=None fix, and public contact form). Backend content endpoints work (auth, GET/PUT, size limit). Frontend overrides ARE consumed by public pages for homepage, testimonials, header/footer, contact meta_title. Found TWO CRITICAL frontend/backend bugs: (1) Service pages (page_key with a slash, e.g. 'services/ai-seo') cannot be saved — the FastAPI route /content/{page_key} does not match slashes and returns 404; (2) Saving an EMPTY string does NOT revert a field to its default — usePageContent spreads override over defaults so empty string wins, leaving hero_line1 blank on the homepage. Also found a UX bug where the 'content-success' toast is cleared instantly by a useEffect on `overrides` change.

critical.issue: Route /content/{page_key} does not match keys containing '/'. Curl PUT /api/content/services/ai-seo -> 404 (both raw and %2F-encoded). This means the CMS cannot save ANY of the 9 service pages, even though the Admin Content Manager exposes them in the page selector. Fix: change route to /content/{page_key:path} and adjust GET to same, OR replace the '/' in the service page keys (e.g. use 'services__ai-seo') on both frontend PAGES + read side.

ui_bugs.issue: The success toast (data-testid='content-success') is cleared immediately after it appears. The useEffect on [pageKey, overrides] runs setNotice('') whenever the query cache refreshes, and save() itself calls queryClient.invalidateQueries which triggers a refetch and thus wipes the notice within milliseconds. In manual use the 'Saved — the page updates within seconds.' message is barely visible / flashes. Fix: don't clear notice/error inside the overrides effect (only clear when pageKey changes), or clear via a setTimeout after ~2.5s.

save() sends the entire `values` map (all defaults + edits) to the backend. Consequence: after the first save of any field on a page, ALL of that page's default values are materialized as overrides in Mongo. Combined with bug #2 below, editing then clearing a field leaves an empty-string override that hides the default. Fix: only send fields the user actually changed, or diff against defaults + strip empty strings server-side.

Restoring a field to its default by clearing and saving does NOT revert to the default. usePageContent merges { ...defaults, ...overrides } so an override of '' wins over the default and the public page renders empty text. Repro: In /admin/content, edit Homepage hero headline line 1 to 'X', save; then clear it and save; homepage h1 now shows only 'Everywhere Your / Customers Are' with an empty first line. Fix: in usePageContent (or backend PUT), treat empty strings as 'use default' — either filter empty strings out of the payload before saving, or when resolving overrides skip keys whose value is ''.

There is no way to fully remove an override; the API only supports PUT with a data map. Not blocking, but combined with the two bugs above, admins have no clean 'reset to default' affordance. Consider a DELETE /api/content/{page_key} route.

integration_issues.flow: Admin Content Manager -> Service page save
integration_issues.issue: Selecting any 'Service: ...' option and clicking Save fires PUT /api/content/services/<slug> which the backend returns 404 for. The UI then shows 'Couldn't save. Check your admin key and try again.' — misleading, since the admin key is fine (see backend bug #1).

action_items: Fix backend route to accept slashes: @api_router.put('/content/{page_key:path}') and @api_router.get for consistency, so service-page keys like 'services/ai-seo' work. Also update the GET/read path.

Fix restore-to-default: filter empty strings from ContentManager save payload (or on backend, drop keys whose value is ''). Alternative: in usePageContent, skip empty-string override values so defaults apply.

Fix ContentManager success toast disappearing immediately: move setNotice('')/setError('') out of the [pageKey, overrides] effect (only clear on pageKey change), or auto-hide notice via setTimeout after ~2.5s.
Optional: add DELETE /api/content/{page_key} to fully drop an override so admins can revert a whole page to defaults.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py PUT /content/{page_key} — must use {page_key:path} to accept slashes; without this the 9 service-page CMS surfaces cannot save.

frontend/src/pages/ContentManager.tsx `useEffect(..., [pageKey, overrides])` — clearing notice/error on every overrides change is why the 'Saved' toast is instantly wiped after invalidateQueries refetches. Split the effect.
frontend/src/lib/content.ts usePageContent — merging '' overrides on top of defaults means editors can never revert a field by clearing it. Filter empty strings before spreading.
ContentManager.save() sends the full values map every save, materializing all defaults as overrides in the DB. Consider diffing against defaults.

success_rate.backend: 100% (9/9 pytest) — but a design bug: service-page keys with '/' return 404 for PUT
success_rate.frontend: 78% (7/9 CMS scenarios verified end-to-end; service-page edits and clear-to-default fail due to backend/frontend bugs above)

DB `content` collection now holds only empty-dict placeholders for keys home/contact/testimonials/site/TEST_cms_temp; the public site correctly falls back to CONTENT_DEFAULTS for all fields (visually verified).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The backend content route only accepts single-segment page_key. That's why the 9 service-page edits fail with 404. After main agent fixes route to use {page_key:path}, retest saving services/ai-seo intro + faq1_q/faq1_a and verify /services/ai-seo shows them and [data-testid='service-faq-1'] reflects the override. Also retest that clearing a field on any page (e.g. home.hero_line1) reverts to the CONTENT_DEFAULTS value on the public homepage (currently it renders blank). If main agent decides to filter empty strings server-side, also verify GET /api/content returns objects without those keys. To fully reset overrides created during testing, PUT /api/content/{home,contact,testimonials,site,TEST_cms_temp} with {"data":{}} using the admin key. Verified working: PUT auth (401 without key, 401 wrong key, 200 correct), GET /api/content (200 public), backend size limit (400 on >30KB data), homepage hero_line1/why_image overrides render via [data-testid='hero-section'] h1 and [data-testid='why-us-image'], 3 testimonial cards render via [data-testid='testimonial-card-1..3'] inside [data-testid='testimonials-section'], testimonials t1_name override renders, site.header_cta -> [data-testid='header-cta'] text, site.footer_tagline appears in [data-testid='site-footer'], contact.meta_title -> document.title, contact form submit -> /thank-you, /admin loads without pydantic crash, GET /api/contact with admin key returns 200 (list of enquiries).
rca_of_the_issue: 1) Service page save 404: FastAPI matches path parameters as single URL segments by default. Route '/content/{page_key}' cannot match '/content/services/ai-seo'. Solution: {page_key:path}. 2) Empty-string can't restore default: In content.ts, usePageContent = { ...CONTENT_DEFAULTS[page], ...content[page] }. Spread order means override '' silently masks the default. ContentManager also sends every field on save, so after any save the whole page's defaults become overrides. Solution: either drop empty-string keys before saving, or ignore empty-string values in usePageContent. 3) Success toast flash: ContentManager's useEffect on [pageKey, overrides] calls setNotice(''). After save() awaits queryClient.invalidateQueries, overrides identity changes -> effect runs -> notice cleared. Split effect: only clear on pageKey change.
